Big Skate length composition data

Source: R/data.R
bigskate_lencomp.Rd

Length compositions and fits from the 2019 Big Skate stock assessment for the U.S. West Coast (BigSkate_2019 in the Stock Synthesis test models), the model used for the r4ss example plots at https://r4ss.github.io/r4ss/BigSkate/. The data are the lendbase rows of convert_output() applied to the output of r4ss::SS_output(). See data-raw/bigskate_comps.R.

bigskate_lencomp

Format

A tibble in the standard convert_output() format with 14504 rows and 35 columns. The columns used for compositions are:

label

"length_composition_observed", "length_composition_predicted", "length_composition_pearson_residual" (as reported by Stock Synthesis), or "length_composition_sample_size" (adjusted input sample size, Nsamp_adj in r4ss)

estimate

Value of the label

module_name

"lendbase"

year

Year of the observation

fleet

Fleet name: "Fishery_current", "WCGBTS", or "Triennial"

sex

"female" or "male"

part

Partition: 0 = whole catch, 1 = discard, 2 = retained

length_bins

Lower edge of the length bin (cm)

Source

Taylor, I.G., Gertseva, V., Stephens, A., and Bizzarro, J. (2019). Status of Big Skate (Beringraja binoculata) off the U.S. Pacific Coast in 2019. Pacific Fishery Management Council, Portland, OR.

Details

Compositions are sex-specific, with female and male proportions summing to one within each year, fleet, and partition. Fishery_current has separate retained and discarded compositions.

See also

bigskate_caal, prepare_composition_data(), plot_composition_distribution()
